text.text: Habits
Log every call or email the same day.
Give every open deal a next step with a date.
Update the probability when a stage changes.
Close lost deals with a one-line reason in the notes.
Run this in fifteen minutes on Monday.
Open deals with no next step have one
Anything past its expected close date is moved or closed
Every proposal older than a week has had a follow-up
New leads are assigned an owner
